full_name: Joanne Baker | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2019–2020 Physical Sciences Edward, Frances, and Shirley B. Daniels Fellow Nature (United Kingdom)
bio: Joanne Baker is a writer and editor based in London. She has edited and written comment, books, and arts and opinion articles at the international science journal Nature for the past decade and formerly was space and earth editor at Science magazine. She has also written three books on physics, astronomy, and quantum physics.
